title: 1958 Governor General Vincent Massey arrives in Hartland
description: On Tuesday, May 13, 1958, the Honourable Vincent Massey, Governor General of Canada, and his wife arrived in Hartland in the afternoon. Massey declared Wednesday afternoon a school holiday, and local children gathered at the train station to celebrate. On behalf of the Queen, he inspected the Boy Scouts, Girl Guides, Canadian Legion, I.O.D.E., and Women’s Auxiliary.
